wl.title: Apply to Wave Link
wl.guideLead: Upload your Wave Link settings file here. We adjust it with your values, you download it and swap it in. Your original file is saved as a backup in the same click.
wl.reafirNote: ReaFIR's noise profile can't be set from a browser: set it up by hand in Wave Link once. Then use "Capture from Wave Link" on the Profiles page to keep it.
wl.pythonTitle: Prefer a terminal? Use the Python tool

upload.lead: Wave Link keeps all your effect settings in one file on your computer. Upload it here: nothing leaves your computer, and nothing is changed until you swap the file yourself.
upload.paste: Copy this path and paste it into the file box's name field, then press Enter.
upload.ok_one: Wave Link file read: {{count}} input found.
upload.ok_other: Wave Link file read: {{count}} inputs found.

error.invalid: This doesn't look like Wave Link's Settings.json. Use the path above to find the right file.
error.noInputs: This file has no mic input with effects yet. Add an effect to your mic in Wave Link, then upload again.
error.read: We couldn't read that file. Try again.

preview.lead: This is what will change in your Wave Link file:
preview.none: Nothing to change: your Wave Link already has these values.
preview.restore: {{plugin}}: put back your saved settings exactly
preview.missing: Add {{plugin}} in Wave Link first, then upload again.
preview.missingRest: Everything else can be applied now; those parts are skipped.

download.lead: One click downloads two files: your new Settings.json and a backup of the one you uploaded.
download.s1: Quit Wave Link: right-click its icon next to the clock and choose Quit.
download.s2: Open the folder from step 1 and replace Settings.json with the one you just downloaded.
download.s3: Start Wave Link again. Your new settings are there.
download.undo: To undo: quit Wave Link, copy {{backup}} back into that folder and rename it to Settings.json.
download.saveDirectHint: Download the backup first, quit Wave Link, then you can save directly.
download.savedDirect: Saved straight into your Wave Link file. Start Wave Link again to use it.
download.directFailed: Saving directly didn't work. Use the downloaded file and the steps below instead.

page.lead: A profile keeps the settings that worked for your mic, room and voice, so you can put them back in Wave Link any time.

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.text: Do a check, set up your effects and record a take with them on. When your effects make you sound better, save it as a profile from the results.

import.error: That file isn't a voice check profile.

capture.title: Capture from Wave Link
capture.lead: Upload your current Wave Link file to keep the exact effect settings in this profile, for example after setting up ReaFIR by hand.
capture.done: Saved the Wave Link settings in "{{name}}".

retest.status: Re-testing "{{name}}": keep the mic about {{dist}} away. Your voice goal is set to the profile's.

save.notYet: Your effects didn't improve the sound yet: fix that first.
save.noFx: Record a take with your effects on first (the last step of the check).
save.gain: With effects you scored {{fx}}, without {{raw}}. It needs to be at least {{min}} points better.
save.regressions: Your effects made something worse. Fix that first.
